claims.text: Gundolpho married Alfrida of the Yale and had three children: Gundahar, Rudolph and Gundahad.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Bolger of Budgeford"

claims.text:
In drafts of the Appendix C, Tolkien at one time had Celador Bolger within the Hobbit family trees, though he was ultimately replaced by Gundolpho Bolger.
